category: 微分方程 / 常微分方程
source_attribution: John Couch Adams, 1883 (catalog metadata only; not a source citation)
statement_blocker: The repository supplies a method-family label and three-word gloss, not a proposition. It does not select Adams-Bashforth, Adams-Moulton, predictor-corrector, coefficient derivation, order or truncation error, convergence, zero-stability, absolute stability, or an adaptive procedure. It also omits the step count, coefficient and indexing convention, ODE and state domains, starting history, regularity and solvability hypotheses, error or stability notion, ordered binders, assumptions, conclusion, and boundary cases. Selecting a familiar Adams theorem would invent or substitute missing mathematics.
target_decision: redirect the catalog method label to a corrected, source-selected exact Adams proposition before ordinary statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix the scalar field, state and error spaces and universes, norm and completeness assumptions, ODE domain and solution model, grid and history representation, step parameter, time interval, and all typeclass data.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose a recurrence definition, coefficient identity, order or local-error formula, consistency or convergence theorem, zero-stability or absolute-stability criterion, predictor-corrector convergence result, or variable-step algorithm property.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every step, grid, history, regularity, implicit-solve, asymptotic, root, and stability boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: the constant-step explicit Adams-Bashforth recurrence derived by extrapolating past derivative values
the constant-step implicit Adams-Moulton recurrence derived by interpolating through the new derivative value
an Adams-Bashforth predictor with one or more Adams-Moulton corrector iterations and a source-specific contraction condition
coefficient, order, local truncation-error, or global error formulas for one selected step count
consistency plus zero-stability implies convergence for one selected linear multistep encoding
absolute-stability or characteristic-root results for a selected scalar test equation
a variable-step or adaptive-order Adams implementation theorem
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: zero step count, zero order, empty or insufficient history, and exact versus approximate starting values
zero or negative step, repeated grid nodes, endpoint mismatch, and finite versus unbounded integration intervals
scalar versus vector states, incomplete spaces, nonsmooth or non-Lipschitz fields, and solutions leaving the ODE domain
implicit equations with no or multiple solutions and correction iterations outside their contraction range
variable steps, step-ratio bounds, adaptive order, accumulated roundoff, and stiffness conventions
characteristic roots on the unit circle or with multiplicity and uniformity of big-O constants
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-1395 finite-difference methods or THM-M-1396 Runge-Kutta methods
THM-M-1398 stiff equations or THM-M-1399 backward differentiation formulas
Euler or trapezoidal special cases presented as a general Adams-family theorem
generic interpolation, interval-integration, ODE, polynomial, sequence, or finite-sum APIs alone
a recurrence or error estimate placed directly in a structure field or hypothesis
a numerical trajectory, convergence plot, floating-point experiment, sampled error, or empirical order estimate
the untrusted catalog label 已验证 used as source or proof evidence
